title: Shared architecture definitions
description: Common fields shared by the standalone architecture view schemas.

id.description: Stable identifier unique within this architecture.

extensions.description: Additional domain-specific properties not defined by this schema.

protocol.description: Protocol, interface, interaction pattern, or security mechanism used by this relationship. Suggested values are not exhaustive; use a custom value when needed.

view.description: Architecture view represented by this document.

name.description: Name of the architecture or system.

purpose.description: The outcome or question this architecture addresses.

scope.description: What this view includes and its relevant boundary.

elements.description: Elements in this architecture, including optional nested elements.

relationships.description: Connections between elements in this architecture.

parent.description: ID of the containing element, when applicable.

children.description: Inline nested elements; their containing element is implied and they must not also declare parent.

kindDetail.description: Specific category when kind is other.

description.description: Purpose or relevant context of the relationship.

direction.description: Direction of the relationship; omitted when unspecified.

directionDetail.description: Specific direction when direction is other.

kindDetail.description: Specific category when kind is other.
